annotations.title: The evidence behind a company's facts

description:
Show the evidence behind what Fuentio says about a company: for each field, the value served and every competing value with its source, record, retrieval time, source link and record hash; and the match decision behind each link.
Use it to justify an answer in a review or an audit. Don't use it to look a company up: call resolve_company first for its entity_id.
Inputs: entity_id (e.g. 'fu_7K3M9Q2XH4PZ'), optional field (name, status, address, legal_form, creation_date, activity), optional as_of 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
Returns: evidence, links, decisions, uncertainty, how_to_check.
Limits: 1 unit. Read-only.
name: get_evidence

outputSchema.description: resolve_company and explain_match (brief 007 P1.7): the service's answer as is.
outputSchema.title: GraphOutput
